# E029 -- Ferrari Brand Guidelines

## Metadata
- **Company:** Ferrari
- **Industry:** Automotive
- **Year:** 2004
- **Source file:** ferrari-pdf.pdf
- **Pages:** 168
- **Language:** IT/EN (bilingual)
- **Pages sampled:** 1-2, 6-7, 12-13

## Brand Strategy
- Document titled "Ferrari Corporate Identity" -- Version 1.1, February 2004
- Two main sections: Section 1 (Logos and Trademarks), Section 2 (Stationery)
- No brand mission, vision, or values articulated -- purely a visual identity and production manual
- Originally created in Adobe InDesign 2.0.2 (September 2003)

## Logo
- Logotype presented in multiple versions with detailed production specs:
  - Standard version (Pantone 426)
  - 3D version -- restricted to headed note paper only
  - B&W line art version -- for printing techniques that cannot reproduce Pantone 426
  - Silver on red background (hot silver or Pantone 877 on Pantone 485 red)
  - Embossed version -- for special applications only
- Two size variants throughout: "Small Size" (<=10mm) and "Large Size" (>10mm)
- Downloadable source files referenced (.ai, .fh, .jpg) for each variant
- Systematic numbering convention (1.1.1, 1.1.2, etc.) for each logo variant

## Typography
- Not covered in sampled pages -- likely addressed in later sections of the 168-page document

## Color
- Pantone 426 -- primary logotype color
- Pantone 485 -- Ferrari red (background)
- Pantone 877 -- silver (special color for logo on red)
- Hot silver foil stamping also specified

## Graphics
- Not covered in sampled pages beyond logo system

- Not covered in sampled pages

## Applications
- Section 2 dedicated entirely to Stationery
- 3D logo restricted to headed note paper
- Embossed logo for special applications only
- 168 pages suggests extensive stationery and application specifications

## Tone of Voice
- Not addressed -- purely a visual/production identity manual

## Outliers
- Extremely detailed production-oriented guide (168 pages) -- reflects luxury brand precision
- Bilingual Italian/English throughout -- each entry has parallel text
- Size-specific logo variants (Small/Large threshold at 10mm) show exceptional attention to reproduction quality
- File download references built into each page -- designed as a companion to a digital asset library
- Created with early-2000s tools (InDesign 2.0.2, FreeHand files) -- historically significant

## Quality Score
- **Score: 3/5** -- Exceptionally thorough for logo and stationery specifications (168 pages), with meticulous production detail befitting a luxury brand. However, narrowly scoped to logos and stationery only -- lacks typography system, photography, tone of voice, brand strategy, and broader application guidelines. A production manual rather than a comprehensive brand guide.
